_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee ciyaarta saddex-ciyaaryahanka Tic Tac Toe. Calaamaddaadu waa '{symbol}'. Waxaad isku beddelaysaa adoo dhigaya astaantaada loox 5x5 ah si aad u sameyso khad afar ah. Khadadka waxay noqon karaan kuwa jiifka ah, kuwa toosan, ama kuwa iskutallaabta ku jira. U gudbi dhaqaaqidaada adoo adeegsanaya qaabka '[4]' si aad u calaamadeyso unugga 4.

board.current_board: Guddiga hadda jira: {board} Dhaqdhaqaaqyada la heli karo: {moves}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qaabka guuritaanka oo aan sax ahayn. Isticmaal '[cell]' halka ay unuggu tahay 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lambarka unugyada aan sax ahayn: {cell}. Waa inuu u dhexeeyaa 0 ilaa {max_cell}.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Qolka {cell} waa mid horay loo qabsaday.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu sameeyay dhaqaaq aan ansax ahayn
